avis.titre: Probably good for a different skin type
avis.texte: My skin feels thirsty after use. I have a hard time getting it rinsed off at the bathroom counter - shower use is a little better. Irritates my skin until I was it off. Still searching for a low frangrance / fragrance free cleanser to support my skin barrier and remove the day. Ulta return policy makes it easy to try items; even though I feel bad returning,
Great gently and moisturizing cleanser. Perfect for sensitive skin.

I loved this product until I read the fine print. I didn't know that this cleanser had niacinamide in it! If you are on an acne treatment or use other retinols etc. this can be over exfoliating and cause worse breakouts or redness. I did experience this unfortunately and wish companies would stop putting niacinamide in everything!

I have dry/sensitive skin and get occasional eczema flare ups, so was super excited to try this cleanser. This stuff has the consistency and feel of washing your face with lotion. Which is totally fine, just something to be aware of. However, this cleanser burned my skin and left it super red and inflamed for a long while after use. Didn't expect that at all from something with the National Eczema Association stamp. I normally use the Prequel gleanser and the vanicream daily moisturizer so not sure what happened. Wish I could return.
I absolutely love this cleanser! I already loved The Calmer and this took everything great about that cleanser and made it more hydrating. I really, really like it.

I really love this cleanser, it is so soothing and gentle. Leaves your skin clean without feeling stripped. It was perfect for me during this cold winter where I was experiencing extra dryness after microneedling. I have combo acne prone skin and had no issues with this product.
Excellent soft cleanser that doesn't irritate my skin or eyes

I have extremely sensitive and reactive skin; even micellar water seems to sting and burn. I bought this on a whim after feeling like I would never find a face cleanser that didn't sting, make my face red, or make my skin feel so tight. This cleanser has been SO soothing on my skin, never burns, and I have finally found something that actually seems to calm my redness. What a relief to have found something finally! I am so grateful.:) And I wanted to leave this review as a big thank you! So thank you!!

avis.titre: It's so good!!!!  Like… really good.
avis.texte: Amazing! Please don't ever discontinue this. It's so rare to find a cream cleanser that makes your skin feel clean, yet not stripped, but more importantly, rinses off the skin fast. Most cream ones take so long to get the slimy feel off. This one rinses away so clean and it is such a lovely formula! I loved the Multi-Calm Body Wash for months now-this will be on Subscription as well. It's so good.

avis.titre: wish it was the best for my skin
avis.texte: I was really excited for this cleanser to release, I've used it only few times and I can't really tell if it's calming my skin/redness down at all, I also can't tell if it's truly hydrating enough, my dry flakes come back within few seconds or so, I have dry sensitive skin. My face was still red on my cheeks. But the ingredients they have in this cleanser are good, maybe this product just isn't for me.

I just got this and only used it twice but I'm already obsessed. It is so creamy and cleansing but it leaves my face soft not stripped. I have oily skin but also rosacea and I still love this. It doesn't make me more oily at all. Just perfectly cleansed and soft 👌🏼👌🏼👌🏼

Please make this jumbo sized!!! This is the best cream cleanser I have ever tried on the market, it's none greasy and has a silky creamy texture that really cleans, I have dry skin that prone to allergies and I have KP on my face and this is the perfect balanced cleanser I needed in my routine. It doesn't make redness and inflammation worse but actually soothes as I clean. Please never discontinue this. Love!!

I used this for the first time tonight and I can tell it'll be a staple in my routine. I have highly reactive skin that can get stripped/red/inflamed with anything along with very sensitive eyes that can't handle fragrance. This cleanser is a luxurious milky cream that lathers, doesn't smell, and rinses off easily. I loved how my skin was instantly softer and more plump looking. My skin also didn't have that dry tight feeling that cleansers can cause; in fact it felt plush. Even after washing my eyelids I had zero reaction. I also appreciated how a little goes a long way so this is a great value. Adding yet another naturium product to my lineup!
